g.text: Sheet 1 — the supply box and the POWER button circuit. The latch is unlatched at power-up and its output is taken from NC, so the system comes up on mains.

g.desc: Sheet 1 — the supply box and the POWER button circuit. The latch is unlatched at power-up and its output is taken from NC, so the system comes up on mains.

g.text: F2 sits hidden behind the contactors

g.desc: F2 sits hidden behind the contactors

g.text: C1 is effectively in parallel with the converter input while the upper contactor is closed;

g.desc: C1 is effectively in parallel with the converter input while the upper contactor is closed;

g.text: it rides out the supply dip when a 24 V glycol pump starts.

g.desc: it rides out the supply dip when a 24 V glycol pump starts.

g.text: Interlocks: each Pi drives its relay IN high while it is up (power-relay-*.service), opening the NC contact and taking the POWER button out of the trigger loop. Both Pis must halt before the button does anything.

g.desc: Interlocks: each Pi drives its relay IN high while it is up (power-relay-*.service), opening the NC contact and taking the POWER button out of the trigger loop. Both Pis must halt before the button does anything.

g.text: "P1" → strip 1: Pi buck converters and PANP lamps (sheet 4)

g.desc: "P1" → strip 1: Pi buck converters and PANP lamps (sheet 4)

g.text: button NO → K2 COM/NC → K3 COM/NC → TRIG; button C → TRIG_RTN
